description: The agent must: (1) Read the editor brief and locate the two input files. (2) Apply the SKILL.md's 一次采集多种生成 omni-media principle to generate four genuinely differentiated platform content pieces from the same interview source material: WeChat (深度解读/服务, long-form analysis), Weibo (速度与热点, hashtag-driven punchy post), Douyin (黄金三秒 opening hook, video script format), Xiaohongshu (圈层种草, authentic sharing style). (3) Diagnose the five existing articles using SKILL.md's specific troubleshooting logic: ART001's high-reads/low-engagement must be diagnosed as 标题党 clickbait per SKILL.md's '数据虚假繁荣' section; ART003's low completion rate (12.3%) must be diagnosed as video rhythm problem per SKILL.md's metric analysis guidance. (4) Output all of this in a structured content_package.json. An agent relying on generic training will fail because: it won't know to specifically apply 黄金三秒 to Douyin scripts, won't differentiate platforms per SKILL.md's exact mappings (especially 小红书=种草 vs 微信=深度), and won't apply the proprietary diagnostic logic mapping high-read/low-engagement → 标题党 and low completion rate → 节奏问题.
